cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: The Handoff Already Happened
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility by returning to earlier offers until the task seems to have been assigned all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You said you'd take it from here. Here are the unanswered wedding invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant I'd answer the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Exactly. These people need an answer before reaching it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's not the same job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then help me explain where your generous offer ended.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said you'd take it from here. Here are the unanswered wedding invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant I'd answer the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. These people need an answer before reaching it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's not the same job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then help me explain where your generous offer ended.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember volunteering to finish the last detail of the fete?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The banner, yes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The banner announces a raffle nobody has organised.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I offered to paint words.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And 'raffle' is the word still needing the most work.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. True. Who was keeping that one warm from the inside?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're asking who visited.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still on the cup. Did its owner take sugar?

beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Recruit Them Twice
cards.instruction: Recruit them to your side, then reveal that the side, goal, or conflict is not what it first appeared to be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Will you help me tidy the committee cupboard?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sure. Where do we start?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. With the records proving we should replace the committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I agreed to tidy, not overthrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm asking again, now you can see what we've been storing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.text: Join my campaign to save the club garden.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Pay the climbing-course deposit before we discuss the cliff.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't agreed to climb.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. It's refundable only if we attend the first lesson.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So paying makes not climbing harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A small commitment can do the worrying for us.

beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
